# Ayush Kashyap — Software Development Engineer II (Tech Lead) · Healthtech

> Software Development Engineer II (Tech Lead) — builds and runs a multi-tenant, white-label
> healthcare EHR/SaaS end-to-end, web + iOS/Android on AWS. 5+ years building production
> software: 3+ years full-time (after a 1-year internship, from Apr 2022: Intern → SDE → SDE II
> (Tech Lead); leads the engineering team), plus freelance and part-time client work since late
> 2020. He is the #1 all-time contributor to the core EHR frontend and one of the principal
> contributors to the core platform. It serves 2,000+ active clinics, thousands of doctors, and
> hundreds of thousands of patients across 100+ specialties, processing tens of thousands of
> appointments a month. Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Dart · React, Next.js, React
> Native, Flutter · Node.js, Express, Flask, Socket.io, Redis · MySQL, PostgreSQL · AWS (ECS, EC2,
> S3, CloudWatch, Polly, Translate) · FHIR R4/HL7/ABDM. Open to senior engineering roles. Based
> in India · open to Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Gurugram or remote; open to relocating. 15-day
> notice.

## Highlights
- Architected and operates a multi-tenant healthtech EHR platform: one product serving 2,000+ active clinics, thousands of doctors, and hundreds of thousands of patients across 100+ specialties, with per-tenant isolation and a white-label layer of dozens of custom-branded deployments — no per-client forks.
- Implemented FHIR R4 / HL7 interoperability for India's National Digital Health Mission (NDHM / ABDM).
- Leads the clinical-AI and speech work (Python): an AI medical scribe, live with a pilot group of clinicians (some AI features in production); led the team's speech-model (Whisper) fine-tuning.
- Shipped clinician + patient apps (React Native) live on the App Store & Play Store — Hermes, Fastlane, OTA updates.
- Tech lead: consolidated the repositories into one GitHub organisation, set up automatic deployment on every merge across the platform, AWS cost-optimisation, and a major React Native upgrade.
- Built Letsdrive end to end, solo (independent client project, 2024–25) — a carpooling + peer-to-peer car-rental marketplace across three codebases (Flutter mobile, TypeScript/Express/Prisma backend with a 13-model schema, Next.js admin).
